noticias.titulo: Nasdaq Futures Rise After AI Stocks Rally in Asia and Europe - WSJ
noticias.resumo:
Nasdaq futures rose after artificial-intelligence stocks rallied in Asia and Europe, though investor sentiment remained muted as oil prices held close to $110 a barrel. 

After volatile trade in the last session ended with the Nasdaq closing flat, futures for the tech-heavy index gained 0. 75% on Wednesday.

noticias.titulo: M&A soaring close to record level, fueled by rush into AI: Apollo’s Sløk
noticias.resumo:
### Dive Insight:

The fixation on AI has spurred dealmaking well beyond technology into companies involved in sectors essential for the AI build-out, including data centers, power generation, power grid infrastructure, cooling and connectivity, Sløk said. 

"AI is the trigger of the AI boom, but it is lighting up far more than tech," he said, noting that dealmaking involving utilities and energy companies posted a record first half. 

Among the largest AI-focused deals, SpaceX in June bought Anysphere, the creator of AI-coding agent Cursor, for $55 billion, according to Mergermarket.
